integrity: Analytical proof and standalone SymPy exact-rational example checks. The underlying single-row rank-one perturbation formula is prior art; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite irreducible equiaccessible jump networks with known support and exit rates, ideal stationary observation, and individual support-preserving row transfers; finite samples/noise, unrestricted joint interventions and identifiability under additional support restrictions are not analyzed.
title: Sharp static-response observability and finite-amplitude tomography of equiaccessible jump networks
